title: Croissant with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF3B0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F2C14E'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD966'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#F5B942'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D98A2B'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='innerGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE69A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F2C14E'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main crescent body -->
  <path d='M16 62
           C12 50, 18 38, 30 32
           C40 27, 50 28, 56 32
           C64 26, 76 27, 84 34
           C92 42, 92 54, 86 62
           C80 70, 70 74, 60 72
           C54 71, 48 68, 44 64
           C40 68, 34 72, 28 72
           C20 72, 16 68, 16 62 Z'
        fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- lighter inner crescent / pastry fold -->
  <path d='M30 58
           C30 48, 38 42, 48 42
           C54 42, 58 44, 60 48
           C64 43, 72 42, 78 46
           C84 50, 84 58, 80 63
           C74 69, 64 70, 56 66
           C50 63, 46 59, 44 55
           C40 59, 34 62, 30 58 Z'
        fill='url(#innerGrad)'/>

  <!-- pastry ridges -->
  <path d='M28 50 C34 46, 42 45, 50 48' fill='none' stroke='#E8A93A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 47 C68 44, 74 45, 80 49' fill='none' stroke='#E8A93A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 66 C40 68, 46 68, 52 65' fill='none' stroke='#E8A93A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 64 C64 67, 72 67, 78 63' fill='none' stroke='#E8A93A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- highlight on top of crescent -->
  <path d='M24 40 C30 34, 40 31, 48 32' fill='none' stroke='#FFF0B8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <!-- left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='54' rx='3.2' ry='4' fill='#5B3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='52.5' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#FFF3B0'/>

  <!-- right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='54' rx='3.2' ry='4' fill='#5B3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='52.5' rx='1.2' ry='1.5' fill='#FFF3B0'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M48 60 C52 66, 58 66, 62 60' fill='none' stroke='#5B3A1E' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#F28C8C' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#F28C8C' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- little sparkles around -->
  <path d='M18 30 L20 26 L22 30 L20 34 Z' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <path d='M80 24 L82 20 L84 24 L82 28 Z' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='76' r='2' fill='#FFE69A'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='74' r='2' fill='#FFE69A'/>
</svg>
